كيف يتم احتساب معاش التقاعد؟: How is the retirement pension calculated?
المعاش = متوسط الراتب الخاضع للاشتراك (أ: Pension = average salary subject to contributions (highest 180 months) × 2.25% × number of months of contribution ÷ 12, up to a maximum of 100% of the average salary.
ما سن التقاعد النظامي الآن؟: What is the statutory retirement age now?
65 سنة مع اشتراك لا يقل عن 180 شهراً. من: 65 years with at least 180 months of contributions. Those who were contributors before 3 July 2024 may be subject to a transitional schedule with a lower age — check gosi.gov.sa.
إذا توقفت عن العمل ولديك 360 شهراً من ال: If you stop working and have 360 months of contributions (30 years), you can retire from age 55, but 3% is deducted for each year you retire early before age 65.
نعم، 2,000 ريال لمن اشترك 180 شهر، ويرتف: Yes, SAR 2,000 for those who contributed for 180 months, rising gradually to SAR 4,000 for those who contributed for 480 months (40 years) or more.
هل هذه بديل عن كشف حساب GOSI الرسمي؟: Is this a substitute for the official GOSI statement?
No, this is an estimation tool only. Check gosi.gov.sa or the Tamminati app for the official and accurate figure.
